name: Gangachara

queries.query: Bangladesh official cadastral parcel map GIS API Gangachara Rangpur land records
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) and its Online Land Record and Survey Management map viewer. The official viewer exposes survey, upazila, mouza, sheet and plot workflows, with public GeoJSON sheet and vector-tile routes in its current JavaScript. No safe Gangachara parcel geometry response was qualified.

queries.query: বাংলাদেশ গঙ্গাচড়া সরকারি খতিয়ান মানচিত্র ক্যাডাস্ট্রাল ভূমি রেকর্ড GIS
queries.result: বাংলা-ভাষার প্রথম-পক্ষীয় ফলাফলে DLRS-এর সরকারি অনলাইন নকশা/খতিয়ান সেবা এবং গংগাচড়া উপজেলা ভূমি অফিস পাওয়া গেছে। Rangpur district is represented in the official map viewer, but the accessible survey chain did not return a usable Gangachara upazila parcel layer or safe ID-plus-geometry response.

registryCustodian.name: Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) / Online Land Record and Survey Management
registryCustodian.scope: National land-record and survey custodian. The official viewer provides survey hierarchy and public map-search workflows; its current client configuration references sheet GeoJSON, parcel vector tiles, and map metadata routes.

localCustodianContext.name: Gangachara Upazila Land Office, Rangpur
localCustodianContext.scope: Official local land-office custodian page for Gangachara; it establishes local administrative land-service context, not an independently qualified parcel API.

service.name: DLRS Online Land Record and Survey Management MapSearch
service.viewerConfiguration: The current MapSearch.js was fetched anonymously. It defines POST JSON hierarchy routes for division, district, survey, upazila and mouza selection; GET /tiles/parcels/{rsnum}/{comcod}/{unitcod}/meta and /{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf parcel-vector routes; and POST /Khatian/GetSheetJsonBySurvey for per-sheet GeoJSON. The vector tile feature ID is client-handled as properties._fid, while parcel metadata exposes dag labels. Native cadastral identity fields were not established from a successful Gangachara parcel feature response.

schemaAndCrs.parcelSchema: Vector tiles and per-sheet GeoJSON are advertised by the client; no Gangachara parcel feature payload was obtained.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Web map coordinates are implied by Leaflet rendering, but no authoritative CRS declaration was returned in the bounded responses.

fieldMapping.clientFeatureId: properties._fid (client vector-tile lookup only; not accepted as native identity)
fieldMapping.displayParcelLabel: meta.dags[].dag (display label; not accepted as native identity)

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: The client constructs the service key from rsnum, comcod, and unitcod; this is service routing provenance, not a proven stable parcel identity.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Anonymous request was not retried with TLS verification disabled because no source-specific exception was authorized. No response was used as evidence.
Official map viewer HTML loaded. Referenced MapSearch.js and its routes were inspected; no login was used.
Current public JavaScript exposed the dropdown, boundary, sheet-GeoJSON, vector-tile, metadata, and khatian routes documented above.
Returned official division JSON, including Rangpur division code 080000000.
Rangpur division lookup returned Rangpur district code 080100000 and service code 4186.
Rangpur district lookup returned one advertised survey, rsnum 201901 (RS/BRS digital survey), marked ongoing.
The bounded request for Rangpur district, survey 201901, returned an empty list. This is a workflow/data-availability result, not evidence that Gangachara has no cadastral data.
Rangpur district boundary JSON was returned successfully. It is administrative boundary evidence, not parcel geometry and was not retained in the cohort directory.

Bounded probes for candidate unit-code forms 080101000, 080110000, 080100100, and 080100001 each returned {"bbox":null,"dags":[]}. No exact-point request was made and no parcel identity or geometry was retained.
No tile request was made because the official hierarchy did not yield a qualified Gangachara unit code and all bounded candidate metadata responses were empty.
No sheet request was made because no Gangachara mouza and sheet identifiers were obtained.

scratchEvidence: tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/2284/ (HTML/JavaScript, response headers, hierarchy JSON, boundary JSON, and bounded metadata responses; no unsafe fields retained)
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native cadastral parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [25.8598540119552, 89.1702492247718] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
An exact-point parcel lookup was not submitted because the official hierarchy did not provide a qualified Gangachara unit/mouza key; this is not evidence of an exact-point miss or citywide absence.
The empty upazila list and empty candidate metadata responses are access/qualification outcomes, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

The official viewer exposes owner/title and other land-record workflows, but no owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No native parcel identity field, authoritative parcel CRS, anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, or citywide vector coverage was qualified; no GeoJSON sample is retained.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The ongoing RS/BRS survey may not expose Rangpur upazila rows through the current public hierarchy, or a different current survey/key may be required.
Candidate unit-code probes were intentionally bounded and not treated as a complete search of Bangladesh administrative identifiers.
The public map may expose more data after a valid mouza/sheet selection or through a separately configured current host.
No independent serial reviewer has qualified a runtime adapter.
